    Certified management systems

    Quality, environment, data.
    All certified.

    HYPNOS operates three management systems certified to international ISO standards and audited by an independent certification body. Hover over or tap a certification to see what it guarantees.

    ISO 9001:2015

    Quality management

    Defined, measured and continuously improved processes: from supply and installation through to after-sales support.

    ISO 9001:2015 · What it requires

    • Documented processes for supply, installation, maintenance and support
    • Supplier control and qualification
    • Customer satisfaction measurement and complaint handling
    • Improvement objectives and periodic third-party audits

    For your department

    Predictable services and response times, backed by an audited method. Often a requirement in public tenders.

    ISO 14001:2015

    Environmental management

    The environmental impact of our work, from transport to waste, is identified, kept under control and reduced.

    ISO 14001:2015 · What it requires

    • Analysis of environmental aspects: energy, transport, materials
    • Proper waste management, including electronic waste
    • Ongoing compliance with environmental legislation
    • Measurable, regularly reviewed environmental objectives

    For your department

    A supplier that reduces the impact of its work on the street and in the office, in line with the Minimum Environmental Criteria (CAM) for Italian public procurement.

    ISO/IEC 27001:2022

    Information security

    A management system (ISMS) that protects the confidentiality, integrity and availability of the data we process.

    ISO/IEC 27001:2022 · What it requires

    • Information risk assessment and treatment
    • Controlled, logged access to data and systems
    • Incident management and business continuity
    • The 93 security controls set out in the standard

    For your department

    Number plates, transits and penalty notices are personal data: they are processed under audited controls, supporting GDPR compliance.

    • Independent bodyCertifications issued by a third-party body, not by the company itself.
    • Regular auditsAnnual surveillance audits and full recertification every three years.
    • Copies of the certificatesAvailable on request for tenders and supplier registers →
